goal: Navigate the robot toward its goal while avoiding blocked paths.
strategy: The robot will navigate towards its goal by moving forward and turning as necessary to avoid obstacles. If an obstacle is detected, the robot will turn and try a new path. If no safe path is found, the robot will stop and wait for a new command.
decisions: If an obstacle is detected, turn LEFT.
If an obstacle is detected, turn RIGHT.
If an obstacle is detected, STOP.
If no direction is safe, STOP.
stop_condition: The robot will stop when it reaches its goal or when no direction is safe to move into.
